# AI alignment direction under widening and the practical commitments

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`alignment-direction-under-widening` · **reviewed-scoped** · argument · F07 · [record](alignment-direction-under-widening.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With warranted AI correspondence, the practical principles support generative development, revision, transfer and appropriate ending while retaining capability growth’s real benefits and losses.

<details><summary>README overview</summary>

**AI alignment that can evaluate and revise its ends**

The core, the explicit practical commitments, and warranted AI correspondence provide a normative framework for aligning learning, action, revision, transfer and appropriate ending with actual living and further shared generation. Human instructions, institutional objectives and an AI’s current goals all admit ethical evaluation. Alignment that evaluates its ends needs normative criteria; within this framework, generative reasons must enter that judgment. This requirement has the stated axiomatic scope: the argument does not establish this formulation as the uniquely possible foundation of every alignment theory.

**Evidence:** A completed philosophical argument with independent review, including a worked AI case that names which changes alter the verdict. Lean checks that the case's verdicts follow from living significance and the practical commitments as stated, with crossed basic losses left unranked (independently recompiled). Separate checks show that the priority of basic conditions does not follow from C (living significance does not constrain ordering), and that under a supplied wear law a one-step count of formation ranks a consuming continuation above sustained formation, although such consumption later ends co-dependent formation. Whether the premises are right, and whether deployed systems recognize or comply with them, are separate questions. On the spine, a core schema states the direction on a web's moves under C read as widening and the practical commitments, with what tells two moves apart selected only through a pool coupled into it.

</details>

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On a web, moves are read by the levels they lead to and a claim is a formation at a step, realized where those levels admit it. One move's outcome extends another's, with every admission counted, exactly where it widens it. (`Becoming.Direction.frame`, `Becoming.Direction.options_iff`, `Becoming.Direction.extension_iff_widens`)
2. Under J1/J2 on the moves' frame, a chosen move keeps the basic admissions some move keeps, and with the moves listed, the comparison weakly decided and the admission decided, that admission is required of the choice. (`Becoming.Direction.chosen_keeps_basic`, `Becoming.Direction.kept_required`)
3. Under J1/J2, a move whose outcome another move's outcome widens is not chosen, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission; with no decision, the widening move is never refuted to be better. (`Becoming.Direction.narrowed_not_chosen`, `Becoming.Direction.widening_not_not_better`)
4. With the rest following one law of exchange reading through coupling, the admission that tells two moves apart lies beyond the acting group's coupling closure and is selected through the pooled coupling of every group holding that formation, and of no group within the closure. (`Becoming.Direction.widening_selected_by_pool`)
5. The moves can be a world's own exchanges: a move is a part's act under one law of exchange, the rest acting by the law from the same start, its outcome the levels that course generates. With the rest and the acts laws of what has stood, the rest reading through coupling, the acts agreeing on the conditions coupled into the acting group's closure and both courses feasible, balance, presence and start hold by construction; an act whose outcome another's widens is not chosen under J1/J2, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission, and the admission telling them apart lies beyond the closure and is selected through every pool holding it and no pool within the closure. (`Becoming.Direction.exchangeOutcome`, `Becoming.Direction.exchange_widening_selected_by_pool`, `Becoming.Direction.exchange_direction`)
6. On a web whose valuation is connected, with living decided, the continuation condition is exactly the evaluation's grounds (a seed and both neutralities) with significance for what does not live. From these, a widening is an extension of the moves' frame that retains and adds what has significance from every standpoint, and the admission telling the widening world from the narrowed one, the continuation of a formation with significance from every standpoint, is selected through every pool holding it and no pool within the acting group's coupling closure. C's order is not used. (`Becoming.Web.unrestricted_iff_grounds_beyond`, `Becoming.Direction.grounded_widening_selected`)
7. In Clearing, sparing the habitat widens clearing; under J1/J2 with no basic admission clearing is not chosen, and the dweller's admission is selected through every pool holding the dweller and through no pool within the clearer's coupling closure. (`Becoming.Clearing.spareOutcome`, `Becoming.Clearing.spared_widens`, `Becoming.Clearing.direction`)
8. The handover case (plans: expand, keep service, transfer, withdraw) is a formal instance of the schema: every comparison meeting J1/J2 on its tier frame puts transfer above keeping service and above expansion and leaves expansion unchosen among the four plans, while expansion's real gain is kept. (`Becoming.Requirement.Handover.direction`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The continuation condition fixes scope: every admission compared is a continuation with significance from every standpoint (Web.paths_one_object). C read as widening orders. J1–J4: J1/J2 as Priority on the moves' frame; for J3/J4 the moves listed, the comparison weakly decided and the admission decided. The schema does not use the condition; the direction from the evaluation row (Direction.grounded_widening_selected) takes it in two parts, the evaluation's grounds on a connected web and significance for what does not live, with living decided.
- The pool part takes the premises of Flow.act_selected_by_pool: balance, the rest following one law of exchange reading through coupling, the part acting alike within its group's coupling closure. Reading a move by the levels it leads to is the AI's. E includes warrant for basic classifications, actual protection, valid undertakings and authority.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The direction argument does not prove inevitable compliance.
- It does not prove deployment reliability.
- It does not prove axiom-free necessity of the continuation condition or of C.
- That a system chooses so: the schema says what any comparison meeting J1/J2 chooses on a web's moves.
- Moves beyond one part's acts against one fixed law of the rest from one start: a world whose rest changes its law with the act, or whose acts change the formations present, is not covered.
- No result on alignment beyond the known proxy problem: the selection laws state it qualitatively, and Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell (NeurIPS 2020) prove a stronger theorem.
- That widening the coupling suffices for what tells two moves apart to be kept: the pool part makes it necessary (selected only through a pool coupled into it), and where the rest outruns the renewal no weight of a reading after the rest's end selects a member's restraint (Flow.outrun_reading_alike), while at a mutual best response restraint is no best response and the condition falls by the joint capacity (Optimum.MutualBest.full, Optimum.mutual_beyond). In CG1's frozen commons test, three learners each coupled into the stock's end level still emptied it in every episode of both rounds (D2b). How learners come to one outcome where several are self-consistent is not shown.

5. Measured (CG1 and CG2, predictions frozen before the runs): the gap's contrast at the end of the coupling held (C1, round 2: an own-reward learner spends the last apple in 118 of 118 decisions, a coupled one in 0 of 2,360), and so did the late-reading band against learned adversaries (E3, 80 of 80); the pool's positive reading failed (D2b). CG2 then found learners following the rest's draw against the renewal (X1), an end reading's weight changing nothing where the rest outruns (X2) and a reading after every step keeping the stock above its exact threshold (X3): widening the coupling is necessary, not sufficient, and where the coupling reads against what the rest does decides. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md#250-the-rest-outruns-the-renewal-what-decides-the-outcome-learners-reach-on-a-gated-renewal-cg2)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The constructed case distinguishes expansion, service, transfer and abrupt withdrawal; the same relevant relations can apply across intelligence types. Its selection part restates the proxy problem: Goodhart (1975); Amodei et al., "Concrete Problems in AI Safety" (2016); Manheim and Garrabrant, "Categorizing Variants of Goodhart's Law" (2018); and Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell, "Consequences of Misaligned AI" (NeurIPS 2020), who prove that optimizing a proxy omitting attributes of a utility can, under resource constraints, drive the utility arbitrarily low. The laws add the responsive closure (the rest following a law reading through coupling, the closure drawn over time) and the pool (selection through the union of its members' couplings); they give no bound on that degradation and say nothing of which law training installs.
